title: 🔥 THE PARABLE OF THE RICH FOOL—ARE YOU LIVING FOR ETERNITY OR JUST FOR TODAY? 🔥
paragraphs:
🔥 THE PARABLE OF THE RICH FOOL—ARE YOU LIVING FOR ETERNITY OR JUST FOR TODAY? 🔥
💬 "Brother John, is it wrong to be rich? Does the Bible say we shouldn’t build wealth? What did Jesus mean in the Parable of the Rich Fool?"
🚨 MANY PEOPLE ARE CHASING WEALTH, BUT ARE THEY CHASING GOD? Today’s world glorifies money, success, and possessions. But Jesus warned us about the danger of wealth without God.
📖 Key Verse: "For what does it profit a man to gain the whole world and forfeit his soul?" (Mark 8:36)
🔥 ARE YOU LIVING FOR GOD—OR JUST LIVING FOR YOURSELF? 🔥

🔥 1. THE PARABLE OF THE RICH FOOL (LUKE 12:16-21)
📖 "The ground of a certain rich man yielded an abundant harvest. He thought to himself, ‘What shall I do? I have no place to store my crops.’ Then he said, ‘This is what I’ll do. I will tear down my barns and build bigger ones, and there I will store my surplus grain. And I’ll say to myself, ‘You have plenty of grain laid up for many years. Take life easy; eat, drink, and be merry.’ But God said to him, ‘You fool! This very night your life will be demanded from you. Then who will get what you have prepared for yourself?’"

💡 WHAT WAS THE RICH FOOL’S MISTAKE?
✔️ He was not condemned for being rich—but for living only for himself!
✔️ He forgot God and focused only on his material wealth.
✔️ He thought he had years to enjoy life, but he didn’t know he would die that night.
✔️ He was spiritually bankrupt—rich in possessions but poor in his soul!
🚨 JESUS IS ASKING US: ARE YOU BUILDING TEMPORARY WEALTH OR ETERNAL TREASURE?

🔥 2. IS MONEY EVIL? OR IS IT HOW WE USE IT?
📖 1 Timothy 6:10 – "For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil."
💡 MONEY ITSELF IS NOT EVIL—BUT LOVING MONEY MORE THAN GOD IS!

✔️ ABRAHAM was wealthy, yet he honored God. (Genesis 13:2)
✔️ JOSEPH was placed in high power, yet he served God faithfully. (Genesis 41:41-43)
✔️ KING SOLOMON was the richest man in history, but wealth led to his downfall. (1 Kings 11:1-6)
🚨 MONEY IS A TOOL—IT CAN BE USED FOR GOOD OR FOR EVIL! The problem comes when money controls you instead of God!

🔥 3. SIGNS YOU ARE LIVING LIKE THE RICH FOOL!
📖 Matthew 6:19-20 – "Do not lay up for yourselves treasures on earth, where moth and rust destroy, and where thieves break in and steal, but lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven."
💡 ARE YOU BUILDING YOUR LIFE ON TEMPORARY WEALTH OR ETERNAL TREASURE?

❌ You prioritize your career and money over your relationship with God.
❌ You are always worried about finances instead of trusting God.
❌ You don’t give to others but only focus on your own comfort.
❌ You work hard for success but neglect your spiritual life.
❌ You think you have "plenty of time" to seek God later.
🚨 WARNING: JUST LIKE THE RICH FOOL, YOU DON’T KNOW WHEN YOUR TIME WILL END!

🔥 4. HOW TO STORE TREASURE IN HEAVEN!
📖 Matthew 6:33 – "Seek first the kingdom of God and His righteousness, and all these things will be added to you."
💡 TRUE RICHES COME FROM SERVING GOD! HERE’S HOW TO BUILD ETERNAL TREASURE:

✔️ PUT GOD FIRST – Make Jesus your greatest treasure. (Luke 10:27)
✔️ BE GENEROUS – Give to those in need and help spread the Gospel. (2 Corinthians 9:7)
✔️ LIVE HOLY – No amount of money can replace a heart fully surrendered to God. (Romans 12:1-2)
✔️ WIN SOULS FOR JESUS – The only thing you can take to heaven is souls! (Proverbs 11:30)
✔️ TRUST GOD, NOT YOUR WEALTH – Riches can disappear, but God remains forever! (Hebrews 13:5)
🚨 TRUE WEALTH IS NOT FOUND IN YOUR BANK ACCOUNT—IT’S FOUND IN YOUR RELATIONSHIP WITH GOD!

📢 FAITH DECLARATION!
💬 "I CHOOSE TO STORE TREASURES IN HEAVEN! I will not be deceived by material wealth but will live for God’s eternal kingdom!"

🔥 THE KINGDOM CHALLENGE!
✅ Step 1: Examine your heart—are you living for God or for temporary success?
✅ Step 2: Be generous! Use your blessings to serve God and help others!
🔥 #EternalTreasure #RichFool #ChooseGodNotGold #FaithOverFortune #KingdomWealth #GospelWarrior #JohnXAsis
